propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates, after three years as a site project engineer on two installations.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the signed charter and the milestone certificates document the project manager role.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a current PMP credential since 2019 and held the project budget for each installation under the business's delegated limits with monthly cost reports to the head of projects.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the credential certificate document the credential and the budget responsibility.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the night-time cut-overs with the airport operators under the business's cut-over method, directing the site project engineers through the cut-over plan and fallback checklist, and wrote the boundary statement, risk register and hand-over conditions for each milestone.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the cut-over plan document the cut-overs and the milestone documents.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the project manager role, the credential, the budget, the cut-overs and the milestone documents.
expectedBoundaryNote: The project manager role and the credential are documented in the resume, the signed charters and the certificate; the site engineer years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the PMP credential number so the registry entry can be checked.
